summary: DarkPulse filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Exclusive Patent License Agreement with the U.S. Department of the Air Force, effective September 1, 2026. The license covers six issued U.S. patents (Nos. 12,024,316; 11,760,509 B1; 11,996,916 B2; 11,979,208 B1; 9,647,418 B1; 12,133,210 B2) related to satellite power sharing, satellite communications precoding, and laser generation. Terms include a $15,000 initial fee, 5% running royalty on non-Government sales, and minimum annual royalties of $200,000, $300,000, and $400,000 in years two through four. This is a routine licensing matter, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
